records.title: The Cognitive Bandwidth Bottleneck: Shifting Long-Horizon Agent from Planning with Actions to Planning with Schemas
records.reason: Compares planning with action lists versus planning with schemas for long-horizon LLM agents as action spaces scale; an agent representation study with no inference-system mechanism.

records.title: SEAL: Scaling to Emphasize Attention for Long-Context Retrieval
records.reason: SEAL learns to scale retrieval-relevant attention heads to improve long-context retrieval quality and extend context limits; a capability-enhancement method, not an efficiency or serving technique.

records.title: BRIEF-Pro: Universal Context Compression with Short-to-Long Synthesis for Fast and Accurate Multi-Hop Reasoning
records.reason: BRIEF-Pro is a universal lightweight context compressor that distills retrieved documents into query-focused summaries at up to 32x compression, directly reducing RAG reader latency and context cost across model sizes.

records.title: Efficient Linear Attention for Fast and Accurate Keypoint Matching
records.reason: Linear attention with global/local attentional aggregation for sparse keypoint matching in 3D vision (SuperGlue-style matching on HPatch/ETH/Aachen); a computer-vision matching method.

records.title: DAS: Dynamic Affinity-aware Scheduling for Heterogeneous GPU Clusters
records.reason: DAS schedules generic deep-learning jobs on heterogeneous GPU clusters using multi-dimensional affinity fingerprints, cutting job completion time over 20%; cluster scheduling infrastructure not specific to LLM inference.

records.title: Adaptive Row-wise Attention Score Pruning and Compensation for Attention Acceleration
records.reason: Proposes two-stage adaptive row-wise attention score pruning plus pruning-aware softmax compensation, accelerating attention computation with higher accuracy and greater computational savings than conventional top-k prediction.

records.title: SpatialClaw: A Memory-Augmented Autonomous Ecosystem for Spatial Omics Analysis
records.reason: Title explicitly frames the work as a memory-augmented autonomous ecosystem for spatial omics analysis, a bioinformatics application domain, with no LLM inference-system subject in the title.

records.title: A Graph Prompt Fine-Tuning Method for WSN Spatio-Temporal Correlation Anomaly Detection
records.reason: Title explicitly targets spatio-temporal correlation anomaly detection in wireless sensor networks via graph prompt fine-tuning, a sensor-network application, not LLM inference systems.

records.title: Human-Like Lifelong Memory: A Neuroscience-Grounded Architecture for Infinite Interaction
records.reason: Proposes a neuroscience-grounded lifelong memory architecture for LLMs (valence vectors, System-1/System-2 retrieval escalation, thalamic gating) for infinite interaction; a conceptual memory framework whose systems implementation and evaluation are unclear.

records.title: Dual Triangle Attention: Effective Bidirectional Attention Without Positional Embeddings
records.reason: Dual Triangle Attention splits each head into past/future triangular masks to give bidirectional attention implicit positional bias, implemented as one compiled flex_attention kernel; an encoder architecture contribution whose inference-efficiency benefit is indirect.
